a11y.reviewedNote: Verified 2026-06-02: nav landmark + aria-label; native details/summary disclosure (keyboard/SR-native). Fixed two real axe findings surfaced by enabling axe on the stories — nested-interactive (link inside summary; branch index now a separate leaf) and listitem (removed role=group from ul). Default/Playground/Example pass axe with test:error; dark theme verified in Storybook. Forced colors: links/icons inherit currentColor via Icon/Link primitives → CanvasText; ForcedColors story present. 2026-07-09 — Promoted beta→stable: 4-mode AT snapshots captured for all required stories, forced-colors re-verified in a real browser, consumers audited.
a11y.playFunctionExempt: Static navigation tree; expand/collapse follows native details/summary keyboard behavior, no custom handlers to drive.
